command: rtk python run_swift_cross_review_controller_transport_v1.py --root . --source-freeze SOURCE_AND_RIGHTS_FREEZE_V1.json --protocol PROTOCOL_FREEZE_V1.json --implementation IMPLEMENTATION_FREEZE_V1.json --out RESULT_V1.json

implementation_notes.active_loop: Each arm refits from scratch on all currently screened rows after every cadence-matched batch and produces a complete deterministic ordering.
implementation_notes.candidate: Frozen TF-IDF plus SGD log-loss controller; stable maximum positive-probability query.
implementation_notes.comparator: Pinned ASReview ELAS u4 TF-IDF, LinearSVC, balanced-ratio 9.8 and stable maximum-query components; this is not exact ASReview application execution.
implementation_notes.deduplication: Label-independent earliest-row retention by within-review normalized content identity.
implementation_notes.initialization: One deterministic label-informed positive and one deterministic label-informed negative per review; no cold-start claim.
implementation_notes.privacy: Source text is used in memory but never emitted to result artifacts.
implementation_notes.review_aggregation: All five reviews are retained; effects are aggregated by an unweighted review-level mean and a worst-review gate.
